governing_rule: An identity candidate is not an identity claim; abstention is a valid decision; unmerge receipts are first-class.
purpose: Define the office that will eventually handle agency, officer, civilian, incident, lawsuit, settlement, credential, employment, and source identity without creating false merges or unsafe public identity displays.
core_distinctions: source identity is not subject identity
agency parent relation is not agency merge
officer appearance is not adverse subject status
civilian identity is protected by default
public record is not public identity display
